note: Settings from the OMEN page to AFO_r1 (run 14). Packet accepted only with magic and version; each field taken only if valid, else the value in use is kept. Held forever, no timeout. Values in use are echoed on 5433 (cols 1-4 side, weight, assist_mode, fixed_k_pct; 15 gyro_cal_request; 16 settings_seq; 17 bif_mass_kg).

fields.name: side
fields.rule: 0 left / 1 right; anything else (e.g. -1) keeps the value in use

fields.name: body_mass_kg
fields.rule: 20..200 sets weight AND BIF_mass_kg; else keep

fields.name: gyro_cal_request
fields.rule: counter, any finite; a CHANGE re-runs the 5 s gyro bias (send the echoed value to keep)
